I — Who we are

Real design experience, built through teamwork.

We are a student-run club that gives students direct, hands-on experience in design. Members form teams, enter external architecture competitions, and work with mentors from concept through to final submission.

We strive to prepare students for life after education: strong design and professional skills, genuine teamwork, and a network of connections, on a platform for learning and for competing.

Real-world experienceTeamworkConnectionsLearning from every outcome
II — Initiatives

Two ways to get involved.

Programme I — General Membership

Open to all Carleton undergraduates.

Join at any point in the year and get access to workshops, critiques, mentorship, competition calls and networking with industry partners, participating as much as your schedule allows.

Join as a general member
Programme II — Competition Teams

Design, submit, learn.

Our most hands-on program. Join a mixed-year team, enter a real architecture or design competition, and work with mentors from concept through to final submission.

See how to take part
III — Updates

What's coming up.

Each year

General Information Session

Meet the executive and learn how to join. Date announced at the start of term.

Every semester

Skills Workshop

Concept development, representation, model-making, rendering and presentation, open to all members.

Annually

Annual General Meeting

Review the year, approve the budget and elect the executive, with at least 7 days' notice.

IV — Industry engagement

Bringing practice onto campus.

We partner with architecture firms, design practices and industry partners to connect students with the wider profession.

Panels & portfolio reviews

Cross-company talks and reviews with practitioners.

Charrettes & workshops

Co-hosted sessions with firms that show real practice workflows.

Networking

Meet potential mentors, internships and employers.

Become a sponsor

Join.

Students can join as general members at any point in the school year. Executive elections are held annually before the end of winter term.
